notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (Nutrition is a governmental fund here), so business_type is null. Beginning cash = total governmental fund balance at start of year (14,813,289, p4), ending cash 13,831,219 (balance sheet p5, also p2). Pages: p1 Statement of Activities, p2 net position, p3-5 governmental fund statements, p6-7 General Fund components, p8-11 General Fund budget schedule, p12-18 other fund budget schedules. Transfers 165,000 GF to Nutrition (net zero in total). Attempt 2: State receipts 6,609,716 (p3) split with the fund schedules (GF p8, Nutrition p15, Bond p16, Special Building p17, QCPU p18) into Homestead Exemption 141,364, Property Tax Credit 3,771,171, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 21,477 and remaining state aid 2,675,704; Other local receipts 39,485 (all General Fund) split by its printed General Fund lines (p8: tuition 15,139, fees 7,853, license fees 4,015, police court fees 276, categorical grants from corporations 1,200, postsecondary 8,502, miscellaneous 2,500); detail 2410 Office of the principal moved to School Administration; balance sheet now from the governmental funds Statement of Assets and Fund Balances (p5, Total column, fund balance by classification), whose totals equal the government-wide net position (p2, 13,831,219). Hidden transfer: General Fund components (p7) reclassifies 300,000 out of Operation and maintenance of plant as the GF transfer to the Depreciation Fund; the GF budget schedule's O&M lines (1,524,033) include it, so detail has a contra line -300,000 plus other financing -300,000 (GF) and +300,000 (Depreciation Fund receipt); the basic statements already show 1,224,033. Detail program lines follow the schedule's own headings (6000 Federal programs -> Federal Programs; 3535/3551 under 3000 non-instructional services stay Instruction as the statement counts them there). Debt service is not split between principal and interest anywhere, recorded as principal and interest combined. Non-revenue receipts 45,961 split into sale 2,000 and other 43,961 using fund schedules. No per-account student activities schedule; Activities Fund one-line budget schedule used. Exhibit of cash disbursements by object (Exhibit N) not in the trimmed pages, so General Fund expenditures are 'not itemized'. Special Building 5400 loan proceeds shown only as budget (3,085,210), actual nil, not recorded. Fund balances: Nutrition beginning (3,975) per p15 versus restated mapping on p4; totals tie. Attempt 3 (2026-10-28 verifier fix): Nutrition Fund 1620 Daily sales - non-reimbursable programs 83,225 (p15) recategorized from reimbursements/refunds to School Lunch Sales (a la carte food sales).
